title: 3x Hairy Cell Leukemia Thriver
content: 3x Hairy Cell Leukemia ThriverRR Admin - MBSNov 5, 20241 min readAngie Netterville is 3 time Hairy Cell Leukemia thriver. Through each bout of this rare blood cancer, Angie has learned and implemented ways to improve health and enhance her quality of life.With a career in physical therapy, exercise had always been a big part of her daily life, but it took a cancer diagnosis to open Angie's eyes to the importance of the other key factors for health. Angie now believes that emotional and spiritual practices should be as routine as exercise and uses her experiences to inspire and motivate others to a healthy lifestyle, mind, body and spirit.For information about Angie's myofascial stretching and wellness practices email her at ilivehealth15@gmail.comListen to Angie's story and others like it here.If you prefer to read the podcast healing story, please visit Apple Podcasts.
